verdict.rationale: The documentation shows real datacenter-scale deployment tooling: communication primitives in ROCm, a Cluster Networking guide, a Network Operator for AMD AINICs, and a Kubernetes GPU Operator and Device Plugin. It also documents a Slurm-compatible scheduler (Spur), end-to-end Cluster Validation, cluster-wide profiling with Omnistat, and Azure availability. Community benchmarks confirm 8×MI355X TP8 serving in a single node. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the GPU-to-GPU interconnect (Infinity Fabric link bandwidth/topology), rack-scale reference system specs, and evidence of large-scale multi-node training rather than inference.
